goal: Build the maximum defensible person-level Chinese historical ruler universe before further bulk distillation.

denominator_policy.review: CORE_REVIEW / EXTENDED_REVIEW are not counted as locked CORE until QA resolves
denominator_policy.collective: collective governments without a unique supreme person are institutional episodes, not fake person rulers

source_priority: polity-specific scholarly/official chronology or primary transmitted tables
MOE/academic chronology and ruler tables as baseline/cross-check
CBDB/person authority data for identity normalization where covered
secondary ruler lists only as discovery leads requiring verification

batches.open: expand named tradition variants without synthesizing false chronology
resolve Shang 30 reigning sequence vs 31 existing packages; 周携王/共和 episode

batches.scope: Qin, Chu-Han, Western Han, Xin/restoration, Eastern Han
Three Kingdoms, Jin, Sixteen Kingdoms and contemporaries
Northern/Southern dynasties, Sui, Tang, Wu Zhou and rivals
Five Dynasties, Ten Kingdoms and extra contemporaries
Song, Liao, Western Liao, Western Xia, Jin, Nanzhao/Dali and contemporaries
Mongol/Yuan, Northern Yuan review and late-Yuan rivals
Ming, Southern Ming, Dashun, Daxi, Later Jin, Ming-Zheng transition
Qing and sustained late-Qing rival sovereign regimes
Republic-era central and competing central governments
batches.endpoint: working cutoff 1949-12-31; post-1949 leadership is a separate modern dataset

next_machine_outputs: update data/rulers-master.json into canonical segment manifest with exact locked/review counts
qa: multiple reigns/offices/polities are episodes, not duplicate persons
posthumous title is not a rule episode
regency is encoded separately unless global policy promotes it
every inclusion/exclusion boundary carries a reason
collective government is not forced into a single person
current 267 packages are existing coverage, never the completeness denominator
